metadata.title: HIPAA Security Rule — Acme Health capstone subset
metadata.remarks: NIST does not publish an official OSCAL catalog for the HIPAA Security Rule. This catalog is the 164.x citations this component implements, aligned to NIST SP 800-66 Rev. 2. Source publication: https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/66/r2/final

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain ePHI to allow access only to persons or software programs that have been granted access rights.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI. This capstone uses a customer-managed KMS key.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use ePHI.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to ePHI that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Establish (and implement as needed) policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence that damages systems that contain ePHI, including data backup.
